summary: Reviewed round 1 and INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED every load-bearing claim with my own oracle copy and my own evaluators. Confirmed: (1) n=5 closed form exact (24/24); (2) the two-minus B-spline law (re-derived from the truncated-power formula, matches oracle exactly at n=6 two-minus = -247808/7 i); (3) the n=6 gate trio from student-2 -- NO factorization poles (channel S={2,3,4}: A_6 -> -187375 finite, A_6*D_S -> 0), homogeneous degree 2n-4=8, and full S_3 wr Z_2 symmetry, all exact; (4) n=7 finite and one-minus identically zero. Bottom line: three-minus is piecewise-POLYNOMIAL, not rational (contra question.md's pole conjecture). I then ran two structural probes that RULED OUT the inner-product ansatz int P_-P_+ and the single-min-threshold cubic block (both non-constant ratios), and established the degree law C=(deg-2 prefactor)x(deg-6 cubic block) which kills all objects bilinear in the two quadratic densities. The n>=6 closed form remains OPEN: a degree-8, S_3 wr Z_2-symmetric cubic spline on the {k_S=0} arrangement. Assigned two complementary attacks (bottom-up per-chamber extraction; top-down structural/all-n derivation).
